tasks.short: Identify case issues and evidence needs

steps.what: Analyze charges, complaints and allegations to identify case issues and evidence needed

tasks.design: Keep case issue identification with the detective reading the original material in {DOCS}. A checklist may prompt consideration of missing evidence but does not decide which allegation is supported.
tasks.previous_blocker: The issue is evidential reasoning rather than field completion.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing source access supports human analysis; no new automation gain is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible story can conceal alternative explanations or missing exculpatory evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Separate legal elements, contested facts and competing hypotheses.
tasks.altitude: Investigative judgement and workload remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Slimme Keuzehulp asks online fraud victims for missing facts using argumentation logic; this narrower capability does not determine investigative case issues.

assumptions: Boundary starts with received allegations and records and ends with the detective's evidence needs, before collection or charging decisions.

Complainants and the existing case intake process produce the source allegations before this task; detective checks source identity, case ID, versions, disputed statements and gaps within the retained100 hours. No structured offence or credibility flag is assumed. Missing information remains an explicit question for manual investigation.
Try existing document retrieval and checklist configuration before any custom development; no new tool is proposed here.
Zero incremental upkeep because the existing analytical process is unchanged.
unknowns: Case types and national procedural requirements
Availability and quality of original allegations
research_questions: Does any clerical gap-checking remain separate from the substantive issue analysis?

already_counted.description: Issue analysis and identifying missing evidence

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Complex and straightforward allegations both retain human issue analysis; no separate clerical baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confirm information through questioning and observation

steps.what: Question individuals and observe persons and establishments to confirm information given to patrol officers

tasks.design: Retain direct questioning and observation. Store resulting notes through the existing {DOCS} process without treating information retrieval as confirmation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verification depends on new field evidence and interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability replaces the substantive task.
tasks.still_hard: Accounts may be mistaken, coordinated or incomplete.
tasks.human_edge: Seek independent corroboration and notice inconsistencies without leading the witness.
tasks.altitude: Field responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Hand over the original account accurately

evidence.claim: Questioning and direct observation are retained human work; no digest case establishes time savings for this activity.

assumptions: Boundary is field confirmation of patrol information, excluding separate report preparation. Overlapping interviews in other task graphs are assigned once in the role roll-up.

Patrol officer supplies original statement, observer identity, place, time and source context before the task. Detective obtains subsequent answers and observations during s1 and records contradictions within its full time. No prior confirmed-information flag exists; missing detail prompts manual follow-up.
Existing record access is sufficient; native configuration precedes custom tools and existing runtime earns no saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool or transferred duty is introduced.
research_questions: Are report-writing minutes being mistakenly included in field confirmation time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Required visits and conversations retain their time even when source records are easier to retrieve.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate with other offices and agencies

steps.what: Agree what information can be exchanged with other offices and agencies
Collaborate with agencies to exchange information and coordinate activities

tasks.design: Use existing secure channels and {DOCS} source packets for human coordination. Keep disclosure choices and negotiation of responsibilities with the detective.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreeing a response involves different mandates, uncertainty and sensitive information.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing secure communications already support the exchange.
tasks.still_hard: A valid recipient alone does not establish that every detail should be shared.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate cooperation while limiting disclosure to its proper purpose.
tasks.altitude: No change in coordination authority or time is assumed.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of police and detectives

evidence.claim: Substantive interagency coordination and disclosure judgement remain human; a generic integration does not establish labour savings for these conversations.

assumptions: Boundary covers the detective's selection, disclosure and coordination, not partner agency execution. Partner officers' existing meeting participation is outside focal time and unchanged.

Detective verifies recipient identity, purpose, source versions and selected content during s1's30 hours; s2 includes the final current-disclosure check. Partner responses arise during s2 before responsibilities are agreed. Unresolved permission means withhold and use existing escalation, not infer a sharing flag.
Use native secure channels before custom integration; no automatic onward distribution is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because there is no changed process or new partner capture requirement.
unknowns: Existing secure channels and partner mandates
research_questions: Which delays are partner waiting time rather than detective labour?

already_counted.description: Disclosure selection, current permission check and coordination

approvals.approved_version: Exact information disclosed, source versions, recipient and purpose at each exchange; changes require fresh approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Coordination and disclosure review retain time; waiting for agency action is not a labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare charges, responses and court information

steps.what: Interpret charges and procedures and verify information for court cases
Copy verified case fields and references into required document forms
Compose case-specific reasoning and approve final charges or court information

tasks.design: Configure {DOCS} forms to copy only verified fields and evidence references. The detective retains procedural interpretation, substantive reasoning and approval of the final preparation packet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated field copying was mixed with legal and evidential judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can map explicit fields without generating allegations or legal reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect source selections and procedure versions can invalidate a plausible-looking document.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what the evidence supports and preserve qualifications and counter-evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry may leave more time for substantive court preparation; charging authority is unchanged.

reach.task: Check court packet references and versions

evidence.claim: Configured document field mapping can reduce repeated transcription while leaving substantive charge preparation human; this is an unmeasured model-knowledge design.

assumptions: Boundary ends with the detective's internally approved preparation packet, not a prosecutor's charging decision or court filing. Those existing downstream actions are unchanged.

Detective produces case ID, participant identifiers, event dates, selected evidence IDs and versions, approved factual field values, template version and required sections in s1's retained40 hours. No structured charge-sufficiency flag is assumed. Missing or inconsistent fields return to the detective for manual preparation; copying starts only after this capture.
Test native templates and mappings before custom code. Already automated form population creates zero additional saving.

Focal upkeep seven hours per100 baseline covers mapping validation, procedure/template version checks and exceptions. Existing records staff are not assigned new data cleaning; three other-role hours cover configuration support.
unknowns: Current forms and court procedure versions
research_questions: Can native templates reproduce verified fields without increasing correction time or changing substantive text?

already_counted.description: Source capture, substantive composition and final packet checks

incremental.description: Mapping and template upkeep plus exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact final packet text, mapped values, evidence references, attachments and procedure version; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gross25 minus7 upkeep net18. Range0-8 allows existing auto-population or mostly bespoke documents at0; repeated standard fields support a smaller saving than the central assumption.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Routine field copying may shrink; case reasoning, witness work and interagency coordination remain human.
reach: Learn document control with records officers
Learn operational coordination with first-line supervisors
role.ambitious_version: A detective who gives clear evidence needs and court preparation grounded in traceable sources.
